notes.title: Hello Tamers! We are back with a little news❤️
notes.notes:
Greetings Tamers!

It's been a while since our last communication, and we're delighted to inform you that our publisher has granted us the support to our work on Re:Legend beyond version 1.0. This decision is crucial as there are still aspects we wish to enhance, furthermore, we’re still passionate about the project. After thoughtful discussions with our publisher, we're content with the outcome.

We express our heartfelt thanks to everyone who has given us the opportunity to realize our dream as game developers and breathe life into Re:Legend. While we aspire to improve various aspects of the game, we also acknowledge the reality that each team member needs to provide for their families. We are committed to doing our best to contribute what we can to the game.

Wishing you all well, we hope to welcome you back to the enchanting world of Re:Legend! Stay tuned for exciting updates and a new micro-feature designed to streamline the bug reporting process.

[b]Development Progress:[/b]
In our commitment to providing a better gaming experience, we've been working diligently on a development plan, and we're excited to share our progress with you. We have included a patch note and the new build will be available in Steam’s beta branch. Once it is stable, we will merge it to the main branch! 

[b]Steps To Access Beta Branch:[/b]


[b]Re:Legend on Steam:[/b]
Open your Steam application and locate "Re:Legend" in your game library.

[b]Game Properties:[/b]
Right-click on "Re:Legend" in your Steam library and select "Properties" from the context menu.


[b]Navigate to Beta Settings:[/b]
Inside the "Properties" menu, navigate to the left-hand side and click on the "Betas" tab.

[b]Private Betas:[/b]
Under the "Betas" section, find for "Private Betas."

[b]Insert Beta Access Code:[/b]
A text box or prompt will appear. Insert the access code "relegendbeta" into the provided field.

By following these steps, you'll successfully access the beta version of Re:Legend on Steam.

[b]Bugs Fixes[/b]
In this update, we've addressed several bugs to enhance your gameplay. Here are some of the key fixes:

[list]
[*] Corrected the description for Tears of Aquila, fixing a spelling error ('crytallized' to 'crystallized').
[*] Fixed the action text box after using Tears of Aquila at the Fountain of Youth, which was previously blank.
[*] Enabled scrolling credits with a controller for a smoother experience.
[*] Ensured the water falling from the jar at the Fountain of Youth does not disappear while moving around.
[*] Ensured the confirm prompt to close when withdrawing fish from the fish book when using a controller.
[*] Ensured small fish and large fish stay in their relevant ponds, preventing them from crossing into the wrong ponds at the Farm.
[*] Fixed an invisible barrier causing a collision issue in the Aqua Farm when surfing a large fish.
[*] Ensured trees do not obstruct the camera's view during the battle of the quest "Heart of the forest."
[*] Ensured the Player’s character does not pass through the map when jumping off their Magnus near the chest in the Goblin's Resort in the Desert biome.
[/list]

[b]Black Screen fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Resolved the issue of players getting stuck at a black screen during certain cutscenes.
[*] Fixed the black screen bug in the affected scenarios.
[*] Ongoing testing to ensure there are no additional instances of the black screen bug impacting other parts of the game's cutscenes.
[/list]

[b]And more![/b]

[b]New Features[/b] 

We added a comprehensive bug report functionality accessible from both the main menu and the pause menu. The goal is to provide a safe space for the players to report bugs effortlessly, while contributing to the refinement of the game.


[b]Streamlined Process Of Bug Reporting[/b]

[list]
[*] Simultaneously, your browser will open with a Google Form, making it incredibly easy for you to upload the files along with your detailed bug report.
[*] Clicking the Bug Report button automatically opens a folder containing three essential files: The Screenshot, Save File, and Log File.
[*] Bug Report buttons are now available on both the main menu and the Escape (Esc) menu for your convenience.
[/list]


[b]Upcoming fixes[/b]
Multiplayer Plugin Update

[list]
[*] We will be gearing up to update the multiplayer plugin to the latest available version, enhancing your multiplayer experience. 
[*] We've introduced a new bug report functionality in Build 1.1.1b. This feature allows you to report any issues you encounter directly from the main menu and pause menu. Our dedicated team will continue to address reported bugs, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable Re:Legend experience for everyone.
[*] New Magnus and weapons set to enrich your gaming experience!
[*] Smoothly transitioning to new horizons.
[/list] 


[b]Digital Artwork[/b]

Finally, to our valued backers, we acknowledge the delay in delivering certain physical rewards, and we want to assure you that our team is diligently working on fulfilling them. Today, we're delighted to share a brief update on our Digital Artwork, soon to be dispatched to all backers who have contributed for this perk.


[b]Sneak Peak[/b]

Kindly view the sneak peak of the artbook under: Artbook Sneak Peak 


We extend our sincere apologies for any inconvenience caused by the prolonged wait, as numerous challenges unfolded during the development cycle of Re:Legend. The impact of the pandemic, with toy manufacturers closing down, affected our plushies and various aspects of the project. We understand the frustration this has caused, and we share in the disappointment from the hurdles encountered on this journey.

To all our backers, please reach out to us on Kickstarter for assistance with refunds on physical goods, changing CD key platforms, or simply to send us a heart and show your support. We genuinely appreciate your understanding and patience.

After careful consideration, we've decided to express our gratitude by offering free keys to all our backers for our future games. This gesture is the least we can do, given the challenges we've faced. We deeply care about each one of you, recognizing that the path of game development is far from easy. Through the journey, we've learned and improved, striving to create better games. We invite you to experience our game, and we humbly ask for your continued support on this incredible journey.

To those who continue to play Re:Legend, your unwavering support is truly appreciated. Your feedback is crucial in shaping the game's future, and we eagerly anticipate hearing from you, Tamers!

Once again, thank you for being an integral part of the Re:Legend Tamer Community!

notes.title: 1.0 Roadmap, Show Your Best Magnus, Patch Note.
notes.notes:
Hi guys! We hope that everyone is having fun so far and enjoying your time capturing all the new Magnus over the week. We know that there's a lot of reports regarding the bugs but please rest assured that we will be addressing all of them as we move forward. [b]We remain fully committed to fixing the game[/b] and the 1.0 release is just a beginning of the game so please bear with us a little longer. With that said, here's a roadmap showing what's coming up next and we plan to continue updating the game until the end of 2023 if everything goes according to plan. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/48719aa0ee3596b202fb6347cfbfcd00ea1eb455.png[/img]

As you can see from the image above, new content will be added all the way to the end of 2023 and while new content are coming, we will be working on bug fixing as well. Regular updates for the game will be rolled out from time to time to address the existing issues so you can enjoy the new content without any issues. 

Next up, we believe that many of you have spent the week playing the game and we would like to see an image of your favorite Magnus! There's over a hundred different types of Magnus in the game and it will be great if you can share your screenshots with us regarding your preference. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/2797b7e965628789bfb437e9f1533fdeeb5cf8f5.png[/img]

You can join our community Discord and post your best Magnus screenshots in the #spoilers channel and we will be picking some of them and showcasing them in the upcoming update that's coming next Monday! Feel free to showcase and share your favorite catch of the week and we shall share it with the world! Here's the link to our community Discord: 

[url=https://discord.gg/Krsmryfghz]https://discord.gg/Krsmryfghz[/url]

Last but not least, here's the patch note on the things that we have fixed so far:
- The control tab disappear when using a controller.
- The fifth page of Caren's Carpenter Shop page is blank.
- "Someone in trouble" quest indicator does not appear on the map once arrived in the correct area.
- The user is unable to interact with the Blip located in Vokka Town.
- Removing a held item into storage does not remove the item from the players hands.
- There are collision issues with Magnus and stairs in different areas of the game. (Frigid Outpost) (Dust Storm)
- The scrollbar of the "option" menu goes to the opposite direction when using click and drag.
- The Volcano Biome meteors are hitting the player after teleporting to other areas of the game.
- A hitch occurs when opening the credit menu on a fresh boot.
- Multiplayer clients who joined Kairoot festival will be stuck in "Waiting for player..." forever.
- Updated Credit Scenes.
- Chopping fully grown trees in the farm will sometimes cause players to be stuck.

We have also added a new in-game bug reporting system and you can activate it just by [b]double tapping the top left corner[/b] of the screen and it should pop up. Click "Send report" and you can insert the details about your encounter and it will be sent straight to us! This will speed up our bug fixing significantly so we would like to thank you in advance for helping out. 

That is all for today's update and we look forward to seeing your favorite Magnus screenshots in our community Discord! :)

notes.title: Re:Legend Launches from Early Access!
notes.notes:
Washed ashore on Vokka Island without any memory... 
You must now start a new life and find ways to recover your lost memories. 
[h3]Re:Legend launches from early access![/h3]

[previewyoutube=kSoje1rGaDA;full][/previewyoutube]
As you explore the land of Ethia, you will find Vokka Island! Here you will learn to survive by farming the land, befriending local villagers, expanding the village and raising your very own magical creatures, known as ‘Magnus’.

These wonderous, mythical creatures roam the land of Ethia.
Every Magnus is tameable and will prove to be a valuable asset and friend. The more you work with them and care for your Magnus, the more they will grow differently, depending on your actions and decisions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/158e8ab64cbe6dbe0728c653739562cc98cd7e40.png[/img]

Reclaiming your memories is no easy task! The world of Ethia is filled with dangerous Magnus and many exciting yet threatening challenges await you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/9bf1cc0b693e1042b0d1d09d1b878cadd3ab0a60.png[/img]

As you enjoy and explore the land of Ethia, you will:

[b]✨ Tame & breed magical creatures
🌾 Cultivate your own farm to acquire food and materials
🔨 Mine, build and craft your own items
🛡️ Forge weaponry and then go off to battle
🏘️ Befriend the local villagers and attend to their needs
🏝️ Adventure alone or with your friends as you reclaim your memories[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/823950/?utm_campaign=Launch&utm_source=SO&utm_medium=TW_organic
[h3]Are you able to survive and rebuild your own Legend? Your fate is in your hands.[/h3]

We want to thank everyone who supported us on this journey - you gave us the opportunity to make this game a reality.

notes.title: Re:Legend is exiting early access on September 5th/6th
notes.notes:
Get ready to adventure with friends, explore beautiful worlds and encounter strange fantastical creatures - as you journey to reclaim your memories.
[h3][b]Re:Legend is exiting early access![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/db15260c8e3b154703011d37c4d1db0daf62d74b.png[/img]

[h3][b]Release timings for launch are below[/b][/h3]
🟦 September 5th at 4pm PDT (US)
🟦 September 6th at 00:00am BST (UK) 
🟦 1am CEST (Europe) 
🟦 7am HKT (Hong Kong) 
🟦 8am JST (Japan)

[h2]What's new in 1.0[/h2]
[h3]Brand New Biomes[/h3]
[b]Tundra[/b] - An icy cold and freezing area where you will encounter a new NPC and a new enemy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/5f221dabcad1e44e9941e59bab80c83bd7c177e4.png[/img]

[b]Volcano[/b] - Remnants of a fallen kingdom filled with volcanic lava. It used to be the largest and wealthiest kingdom of all. Who will you meet behind the gates?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/0f3f3ba55dfcd711838d6d09491d4dfa69a1b4f2.png[/img]

[h3]New Story and Final Chapter[/h3]
The complete story of Re:Legend with quests that will bring you to your epic conclusion in the World of Ethia. 
There are plenty of encounters along the way as you venture deeper into the story. 

[h3]New Magnus[/h3]
The Tundra and Volcano Biomes are inhabited by a total of 58 BRAND NEW Magnus. All of them are tameable and if you show them their favorite food, they might become your friend. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/234be22378f30fefe30d9b0d0152029c0073a14a.gif[/img]

[h3]New Armor and Weapons[/h3]
With the addition of the new biomes, you will be able to collect new materials from the wild and defeated enemies to craft stronger and better equipment. There’s a total of 111 new equipment pieces that you can craft.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/0bed8ec0ec2ceb2f8e79365ac3fbf90530f23b2d.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Fish[/h3]
There are plenty of fish to catch in the wilderness of Tundra and Volcano Biomes, and they come in various sizes and appearances. Each of them have adapted to their local environment and thrived over the years so you are free to catch 'em all! 

[h3]New NPC and New Shop[/h3]
You will be encountering a new and recruitable NPC in the upcoming release and he will be able to provide you with lots of stylish costumes. 
There's never enough costumes to wear in the game, are there? 
With the opening of the new cosmetics shop, you will be able to purchase new outfits and decorations, and zoom through your adventure with style! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/d64008cf1bc087b2f25bc6967d9a1bf7d3f5775a.png[/img]

[h3]Other Good Stuff[/h3]
The newly added content list goes on and on, but we cannot cover them all in detail - so we compiled a list below - enjoy!:
●	New Skill Runes
●	New House Decorations
●	New Barn Floors
●	New In-game Vanity
●	New User Interface
●	New VFX & Sound Effects
●	New Achievements
●	New Marriage System
●	New Stats Reset System
●	New Cloud Save
●	Fixed Over 9000 Bugs!

[h3]Balancing & Rework[/h3]
Some of the old content has been rebalanced or reworked to make the game better:
●	Overhauled Multiplayer System
●	Magnus Stats Improvements (Balancing and implemented affiliated stats)
●	Player Stats Improvements (Balancing and implemented affiliated stats)
●	Life Skill Improvements and Balancing (Adjusted Level to Lv30)
●	Stamina Re-balanced
●	Item Drop Rate Re-balanced
●	Player Equipment Re-Balanced (Buffed)
●	Crops Re-balanced (Harvest Time)
●	Economy Re-balanced
●	Adjusted Quest Difficulties
●	Game Optimisation (Improved FPS & Memory Usage)
Due to the sheer amount of stuff being added and reworked, old save files may not be compatible with the 1.0 version of the game (for example, Life Skills are now adjusted to Lv30 instead of Lv10 in EA). A new save file is required in order to play the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/697a82e94ce4ed477e14ffae2e61025447e63c08.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Re:Legend's Road to 1.0 Milestone Update #8
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and welcome back to our monthly update for May 2021. First up, we would like to thank everyone for their patience and support thus far for Re:Legend. This month we would like to explain what is currently going on with the project and how things are going.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/4018a0af309ca379769500b0d817efdad9bba1a4.png[/img]

As you all have known, we are currently in the process of overhauling the multiplayer system for Re:Legend and have effectively caused a delay in the release date of the game. We are deeply frustrated about this as well and we sincerely apologize for the delay of 1.0 and we know many of you were excited for the release of 1.0.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/e840a64a8b8146a365e4e64210bd4c9bafafc363.png[/img]

The multiplayer system currently in place is causing major instability between players outside of Asia and we have identified the problems within the system and also came to the conclusion that a simple fix won’t be able to achieve the stability that is acceptable. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/1326e181add0bb09281964100ae9d6ad5e39f12d.png[/img]

We are working closely with 505Games to address this issue and the solution so far is to have a multiplayer structure overhaul. Our previous plan was to restrict the maximum number of players to 2 players but with 505Games’s assistance, we should be able to achieve 4 player multiplayer in a much stable state.

Re:Legend is our baby project and we really want it to be released in the best state that it can be and that is why we made the hard decision to overhaul the multiplayer system and delay the release. We are currently working with the fine folks from 505 Games to push the game towards the goal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/69bab6bf43323b7d93878dbb7590245a451c393c.png[/img]

As of right now, we are also planning to release the console versions together with the 1.0 launch so don’t worry if you’re looking forward to the console version, we got you covered! We’re truly sorry if you’re disappointed with the delays but believe us, we’re equally frustrated as well. The last bits of the development is usually the hardest part as the pesky bugs can be difficult to spot and eliminate.

We are trying our best to deliver Re:Legend in it’s best possible state so we hope that you will understand our circumstances and be a little bit more patient as we promised the game is gonna be released within this year. More about the release date will be announced in the near future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/712708494fe19e2b462912e8b1cdddd5aa2859e8.png[/img]

That is all for this month’s update and we would like to thank everyone for the continuous support, bug reports and translation suggestions from the community. If you have more feedback on the changes we have done, feel free to reach out to us. Together we can continue to improve Re:Legend!

[b]Join our Community:[/b]

Community Discord: https://discord.me/relegend

Official website: https://www.play-relegend.com

Official Facebook page (@playrelegend): https://www.facebook.com/playrelegend/

Official Twitter account (@playrelegend): https://twitter.com/playrelegend

notes.title: Re:Legend's Road to 1.0 Milestone Update #7
notes.notes:
Hello peeps! Welcome back to our monthly update for April 2021. We hope it is going well for everyone as we continue on deep into the year 2021. It has been quite a ride for us here and we have worked on and released multiple major contents as the months pass by. Today however we have news on the state of multiplayer in the current version of Re-Legend.

As you all have known, our team has been working hard optimising the multiplayer experience in Re-Legend and has shifted a lot of focus on squashing bugs pertaining to multiplayer. Our team has also done multiple test runs with many different variables based on internal reports and community reports and proceed to find the root of the issues of many in multiplayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/7efef4af3978ad682f2a2d621c7f6f2496038ea3.png[/img]

When we started to focus all of our resources on multiplayer, the situation had many visible improvements and multiplayer was stable from our internal testing and some community feedback. But we have noticed that stable multiplayer sessions only happened within Asia and some countries but are still unstable in North America and Europe as a whole.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/e840a64a8b8146a365e4e64210bd4c9bafafc363.png[/img]

That threw a wrench into our plans of releasing Re-Legend 1.0 as soon as possible but we were extremely worried that the state of multiplayer will sour the experience because that is what we promised, a working multiplayer experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/9bca9fbf44975c0bd1e0a9ccccae15987e2bc123.png[/img]

After careful consideration, we have decided to overhaul the multiplayer system so that we can deliver the full satisfactory multiplayer experience on the full game launch and make sure it is a product that we all can be proud of. Part of the problem with the state of the current multiplayer network infrastructure is due to not having a team in North America and Europe to work on the connectivity issues as we are based in Asia. Network infrastructure of western countries and Asia might also differ and this meant that more time is needed to work on multiplayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/e5ff66e9ee0ed8d9090aae756953e875e0f381d1.png[/img]

This means we are pushing back the release of 1.0 due to all the work that needs to be done on multiplayer and we will release a new roadmap of the overhaul process of Re-Legend’s multiplayer soon and the release window will still be within 2021.

That is all for this month’s update and we would like to thank everyone for the continuous support, bug reports and translation suggestions from the community. If you have more feedback on the changes we have done, feel free to reach out to us. Together we can continue to improve Re:Legend!

[b]Join our Community:[/b]

Community Discord: https://discord.me/relegend

Official website: https://www.play-relegend.com

Official Facebook page (@playrelegend): https://www.facebook.com/playrelegend/

Official Twitter account (@playrelegend): https://twitter.com/playrelegend

notes.title: Re:Legend's Road to 1.0 Milestone Update #6
notes.notes:
Hello peeps! Welcome back to our monthly update for March 2021! First up, we hope you have been enjoying the Localisation Beta that we have released last month and we would like to thank everyone in the community who has come forth with suggestions for better translations in their native language. You guys are awesome! Today we would like to share some of the things we have been working on for the past weeks and upcoming content of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/c2e2ec39a133fd1770fb9c21d4d1d483f9945478.png[/img]

To start things off, we would like to show you some of the challenges that you might face in the Frigid Tundra Biome! As you set off to explore the Tundra, you will come across some challenging boss fights as you solve the quest on the Island. We will be showcasing the boss fight without spoiling the story so don’t worry about spoilers. The Goblem excels at physical close range attacks and a mighty lazer beam so make sure stay alert and don’t get hit! Here’s a little gif of him firing his laser.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/8ce4561d18e79c0310de2ac00728ddb256738604.png[/img]

Next up, you will come across a dark and sinister boss, The Harprine, while you’re going through the Frigid Tundra. She is a new Magnus variant that you are going to face in the new biome so we’ll leave the exploration to you. She is specialized in wide mid range attacks so get ready to dodge its skills to defeat it! Another thing to note is that she deals physical and magical damage so be sure to get both of your defences up or you will be shredded!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/02912058fb1a28c2ce2dbf1894c40d9ba28fe000.png[/img]

While we’re on the topic of Tundra content, here’s a little sneak peak of the most crucial part of the biome itself:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/d41f44f78093f97a76b138047c66a17b9299b96f.png[/img]

What happened here, and is that… the Guardian? And who is this guy? What happened to both of them? You’ll find out more about them as you play through the main quest of the Tundra Biome! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/7c191435836c75c3381d12299903a20f64161c57.png[/img]

Moving on to the next topic, we have observed that the difficulty of the bosses you encounter in Re:Legend have been quite mixed and some are a little difficult, and some are a little too easy compared to the challenge they should have posed at that given level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/2f3e53dc26471772e1b65fd37eccd155241cba75.png[/img]

To counter this issue, we had taken the time to rebalance all of the bosses and mini-bosses that you will encounter throughout the story from the Prunperor in Coastal to the Agriz in Desert. Even those little mobs that you will be encountering throughout the quest are re-balanced so they should be more in line with the expected strength of the player at the level they are expected to encounter them. We hope that the game will be more enjoyable as we tweak them to smoothen the gameplay.

Lastly, we would like to talk about multiplayer improvements on the Beta branch and release date. We have done a lot of internal testing and working on squashing as many bugs as possible and also working on improving performance for multiplayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/7efef4af3978ad682f2a2d621c7f6f2496038ea3.png[/img]

We have updated the Beta Branch on Steam with our new multiplayer improvements and the stability of the multiplayer within the same country seems to be stable. However, there were mixed reports from testers around the globe when it comes to cross country connection. There are cases where players are able to play smoothly without disconnections for the whole day while some experienced disconnection several times within an hour. We know that our estimated release date was within Q1 but due to this reason, we felt that the multiplayer can still be improved upon and we’re not satisfied with the current stability of the game across long distance. We cannot call it 1.0 when some of the players are still not able to enjoy the game properly when they are far apart. We understand that due to the pandemic, many people are separated so we want to make sure that the experience that we deliver will be satisfying instead of frustrating. We’re sincerely sorry about moving the 1.0 date and please be patience with us as we work towards delivering a smoother experience of the game.

Do join our Discord as we will continue to update our mini progress in the channel and interact with the community. We would also urge more of you to try out the multiplayer in the Beta Branch and inform us about your experience of the game. It would help us greatly if we can receive useful feedback regarding the stability of different regions around the globe.

That is all for this month’s update and we would like to thank everyone for the continuous support, bug reports and translation suggestions from the community. If you have more feedback on the changes we have done, feel free to reach out to us. Together we can continue to improve Re:Legend!

notes.title: Re:Legend's Road to 1.0 Milestone Update #5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are back for our monthly Update for February 2021! On this update, we would like to share what we have been cooking for the past 6 months and it is pretty exciting as 1.0 is approaching. (REALLY SOON)

First off, we would like to recap on the recent release of the localisation patch that was released through Re-Legend’s Steam Beta branch and make sure to check it out if you missed out on the patch! Anyone who owns the game right now on Steam will have access to the beta branch and there are a total of 10 languages available and if you find any translations that could be improved in your native language, please drop us a message and let us know!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/d161c2ad7794fb181d820e63fe9e02aaab612383.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/e9cd50415d44b364dcc191d59647d013b2719049.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/c5013a6da67728ff2b04c06dcb2cc23fa6b37c60.png[/img]

For those of you who are not aware of how Steam’s beta branch works, here’s how to access it: 

1. Right click Re:Legend in your Steam Library
2. Select Properties and click the BETAS tab.
3. Insert "[b]RelegendLoc2021[/b]" code to unlock the branch. 
4. You shall see Localisation Beta in the option.
5. Download and patch the game.
6. You’re good to go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/81ac328dfd3960f6a177ceb233a9b36213d06ad8.png[/img]

To change the language of your preference for Re-Legend, you can navigate to the Options Menu which is accessible in both Main Menu and Pause Menu. Navigate to the Language section and click on the language that you wish to play Re-Legend on.

The 10 languages that are available:
[list]
[*] English
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Traditional Chinese
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Thai
[*] German
[*] Spanish
[*] French
[*] Italian
[/list]

Most of the translated content should be in the game right now but please send us reports or feedback if you find any issues with the translations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/04ae911c2dc0ea977a896c13c7559ee8d6cc80dd.png[/img]

Next up, we would like to show you a sneak peak of the two biomes that are coming your way soon during the 1.0 release. These biomes are the opposite of each other and offers a totally different experience compared to each other. Of course, the story that was left off in the Everdust Desert will also continue with these two biomes as well. Don’t worry, we’re not gonna spoil the story for you. ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/c9c028ff406fef9b629d5cbd4b18fbc197d03367.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/6db7d12b933bb21f6a80d78ddef936979881f828.png[/img]

First off, the Frigid Tundra is a freezing land full of snow and ice in Ethia. This biome houses a lot of unique Magnus that have adapted to its surroundings. Some of them have thick fur coats while others have learned to wield the elements of ice as part of their arsenal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/fdd76984308bd0f97e9718db1412beb323de0c4e.png[/img]

The Frigid Tundra is beautiful and despite it having snow all year round, flora seem to be flourishing and there are talks about beautiful settlements and ruins to discover. So put on your fur coats and have fun exploring the Tundra!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/a1af84531b700b294817693b206fb300ff578b0c.jpg[/img]

The next biome we would like to show you is the Volcano biome! The land of the Ruined Kingdom is full of volcanoes and lava while volcanic smog fills the land. The Magnus here too have adapted like the Tundra biome but instead of thick fur coats, they have heat-proof scales or even wield the flames and heat as one of their own ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/19aa4bf188818325aa5307088cb19a27ead58593.png[/img]

The land of the Ruined Kingdom is what’s left over of its former shadow and as its name implied, it’s haunted and reeks of adventure! Be sure to gear up with your best gear because the adventures here will be a dangerous one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/c1a65b7950778fb9da446def44197f5517aadc3c.png[/img]

Last but not least, we would like to say that a ton of content is coming in 1.0 and it won’t be long before you can take on more bosses, join Guilds and help out new friends in new quests, discover new Magnus including Magnus Fusions, Marriage and just much, much, much, much more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/681b9cbb9e10f3383327ee40047f3854a8ffbbd5.png[/img]

That is all for this month’s Update and we would like to thank everyone for the continuous support, bug reports and translation suggestions from the community and together we can continue to improve Re:Legend!

So what do you guys think of this month's Update? Do let us know in the comments and social media platforms listed below. We hope to see you again next month! :)

Join our Community:

Official website: https://www.play-relegend.com

Official Facebook page (@playrelegend): https://www.facebook.com/playrelegend/

Official Twitter account (@playrelegend): https://twitter.com/playrelegend

notes.title: Re:Legend's Road to 1.0 Milestone Update #4
notes.notes:
Hey guys! How is everyone doing so far? Can’t believe the first month of 2021 is almost over and we will be bringing you a new update! On this update, we would like to share what we have been working on for the past month and it is pretty exciting as we get closer to the release of 1.0.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/335fa56ec9eaf48fb548aefcfdd0d517cf361836.jpg[/img]

First off, do you ever feel like you don’t have enough storage to store all that sweet sweet loot you have been collecting? Were you agonizing on which to keep and which to throw?

Well you don’t have to fret no more as there is now a way to upgrade your house’s storage space! The new upgrade will be sold by our lovely Emilia in the Vokka Village at a fair price.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/f1e18c79b7942ce4b5c9dca58f543a2c9491b464.png[/img]

Each purchase will add an extra storage page to your house storage and it caps out at 20 pages, so all you hoarders out there can rejoice! We’re pretty sure 20 pages of storage space will be sufficient for now but do let us know if you’re still running into storage space issues again as all your feedback are taken into consideration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/532ed4e462dd13a6d9652b130994e9f3f78c6791.png[/img]

Next up, we have some improvements over the accessibility of the multiplayer as it was one of the most requested part of the game to be improved. You can now invite your friends through the ESC menu directly without having to travel back to town making the whole experience a lot more smoother and less cumbersome. Isn’t that awesome?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/e840a64a8b8146a365e4e64210bd4c9bafafc363.png[/img]

You can now start a multiplayer game in the ESC menu and invite your friends through your friend list. Your friends will still appear in the Guildhouse as usual but now you don’t have to stop what you are doing and travel all the way to the Guildhouse to invite your friends. We have heard a lot of complaints about having to travel all the way back to the Guild House if one of your friends have disconnected so we made this quality of life improvements to make your life easier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/fe07dd8dc04a8a59d4511a6ee5bc24b599992951.png[/img]

Another quality of life improvement that we have made is that we have also added Save Game functionality to the Quit Menu so that you can save your game anywhere and anytime. There’s a pretty lamp in your house that you can save your game but we realize that it might be choresome for some players so we made sure it is much more accessible.

Last but not least, have you ever felt like the path you have taken wasn’t what you imagined? Wished that you have taken up magic instead of the sword? Or maybe you wished that you had more health and defense and can do without overwhelming damage?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/20e059005dd92554ea8f31db7f3e5cf610b0e8c9.png[/img]

Fear not, as it turns out there is a rumour going around that if you come across the Tear of Goddess and bring it to a special hot springs and throw the tears in it, it will change and sparkle a celestial glow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/307d8e3b861c0a307573a245eff32cc74e9ec0cb.png[/img]

It is said that if you bathe in it, you can be reborn and take on the path that you wish. Nobody knows how to acquire the tears and it is for you to find out in the game.

As for localization, we apologize for the delay but we have now imported all the languages that were planned and are doing rigorous testing and quality checks to ensure all the user interfaces are working as intended and all the fonts and languages play well with each other. There were some issues about the user interface previously and that has been resolved.

We are playing through the game with these languages to ensure we catch any bugs beforehand and squash them as much as possible!

Another part of the game that we have been working hard on is the multiplayer experience, especially the 4 player sessions. 2 players experience is largely stable and in a very playable state but we are focusing on connection stability of 4 players sessions. We’re planning to release a Beta branch for multiplayer testing on Steam and we’ll post an update on the release of the branch. Meanwhile, keep the bug reports coming as we continue to make Re:Legend better!

We would like to thank everyone for the continuous support and bug reports from the community and together we can continue to improve Re:Legend!

So what do you guys think of this month's update? Do let us know in the comments and social media platforms listed below. We hope to see you again next month! :)


Join our Community:

Community Discord: https://discord.me/relegend

Official website: https://www.play-relegend.com

Official Facebook page (@playrelegend): https://www.facebook.com/playrelegend/

Official Twitter account (@playrelegend): https://twitter.com/playrelegend

notes.title: Magnus Lore Reveal #59 Tyranniz
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/b5a848a3994b41350fe6b99e90ebe4adba5b61a3.png[/img]

Deep within the blazing lands of the Ruined Kingdom lies an apex predator that rules the land. This fiery towering Magnus inspires fear and awe to anyone that happens to encounter them and they are called Tyranniz for the tyrannical aura that oozes out from them.

The Tyranniz sports giant green claws that can make quick work of their enemies or prey alike. Their tails are fashioned with sharp green spikes which can be detached and shot towards any target of their choosing making them deadly both up close and at range. On top of that, they are also capable of breathing fire, burning their foes to a crisp.

Many adventurers that had visited the lands of the Ruined Kingdom would often pray to Aquila so that they would be out of harm's way and not encounter a Tyranniz. Interestingly enough, there have been reports of Tyranniz sighting outside of the Ruined Kingdoms and they were reported to have appeared all the way from the Coastal Island of Vokka till the freezing lands of the Frigid Tundra. It is unsure how they came to appear in those lands, but this is a mystery I would like to solve.

Head Librarian,
Figaro

notes.title: Magnus Lore Reveal #58 Pyregon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/613b43e2651d11bc4f36b2f8afac9b8c450c6bdc.png[/img]

When I first encountered a Pyregon, I was baffled how this cute little magnus eventually evolved into a huge terrifying magnus. These giant magnus found in the blazing lands of the Ruined Kingdom often strikes fear in many that have laid eyes on them. But yet, the small little Pyregon seems harmless at best, portraying a cute and cuddly outlook to wandering adventurers.

The Pyregon are often seen roaming around with nary a care in their mind and will not engage on people even when being close in their vicinity. When provoked, they do not hesitate to burn their aggressors with powerful fire magic that they wield as consequence of being part of the drake species.

Interestingly enough, one of the evolutionary paths of the Pyregon seems to lack any semblance of fire magic in it’s arsenal at all. One of the theories suggested that this line of evolution lost it’s fire magic capability due to its diet being plant based and we all know that plants and fire do not go well together. Perhaps it trades it’s fire magic for the ability to handle fragile plants as opposed to the other evolution whose diet consists of meat or ores.

Head Librarian,
Figaro

notes.title: Early Access Major Patch, One Step Closer To 1.0!
notes.notes:
Hey guys, we hope that you have been doing well this past month. It’s been a challenging time for all of us and we hope that this month’s Kickstarter Update will bring you joy and excitement as we share some of the things we have been working on for the past several months. As we are gearing up to the release of 1.0, we have a Gigantic patch update coming to the Steam Early Access build on [b]27th of November[/b], so mark your calendars fellow Tamers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/c7802ede8489f87f9ccc2bb9b5301cc6797cc452.png[/img]

First of all, the console porting of Re:Legend is being worked on right now and we are working on all kinds of optimization to ensure it is able to run smoothly on console devices. As a result, we have a little teaser to show you. Here is Re:Legend running on the Nintendo Switch. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/104f432218bf91c403278611f8a2d6654609ad25.png[/img]

There are a few things we need to iron out to ensure that the best experience for Re:Legend is delivered to all platforms. We are striving hard to meet those standards and we sincerely hope that this little teaser will get you hyped up as we go through this Kickstarter Update. We aim to [b]release Re:Legend on all platforms and 1.0 within Q1 of 2021[/b], which is happening really soon!

[h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3]

For the Early Access patch update which is going to be released on this upcoming Friday, we have integrated new features that we have teased all the way back to the previous patch. We know it’s been some time since we have patched the game but now it’s finally here for you to experience them. We have compiled a list of changelog and bug fixes at the bottom of the thread so bear with us as we go through all the exciting news. 

First up, we have Runestones and the two main Runestones showcased were [b]Field of White and Firestorm[/b] for a symphony of fire and ice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/fadd1ae36745828d0b031321af9d5549bfa90294.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/3999bf5ae8b0b83351014d4682c56e13661fa29b.png[/img]

These two Runestones provide extra layers to your combat and can be found in Yuri the Witch’s shop along with other new Runestones that were added to the game. Runes will make your life easier and significantly improve your experience of the game. Be sure to try them out and tell us how you feel about them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/80c1ce3f130326d66f46088573504f436bc67f24.png[/img]

Besides that, Papa Pia’s Pearl Shop is also open for business for you to spend all your hard earned Pearls that you have won through Fish Racing on useful items. More items will be added to the pearl shop as we patch the game gradually in the future. You can trade for fishing related items or the most sought out Gigantizer! Just in case you don’t know what it does, it can make your crops grow extremely big!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/55291851d34fb4cf24bc961ff7deeb65c9a2c7d0.png[/img]

Next up we have Caren, our lovely Vokka carpenter who is now ready to sell you handmade furniture for your dream house customization which is another feature coming to the game. 

We believe that house customisation has been a feature that a lot of you have been waiting for and it is finally going to be released! You can now [b]purchase furniture, decorations, wallpapers, floor tiles, cooking tables, and more[/b] from Caren’s shop after the patch. Once the furniture is bought, you will be able to customize your home freely and live with style! Do share with us what kind of furniture you would like to purchase so we can release more of them in the future. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/6fef172d5678b49014127c50aaf9cd1e530cb6c0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/e1bf93e5f829df55a593b1b60a49522435d206e9.png[/img]

During the EA launch, we realised that the majority of players are not utilising Magnus to their full extent because it is inconvenient to go back to the Barn and re-adding them to the party. To combat this issue, we have added a feature where you can[b] revive your friendly partner on the spot! [/b]

It is now possible to wake your partner up when they are defeated in the battle so you don’t have to run all the way back to the barn. They will be able to join you in battle with a slight delay of 5s if you are able to give them moral support. Keep in mind that if you leave your partner fainted while moving on to another location, it will damage their trust and it will take some time to regain their lost trust. In order for your partner to shine and evolve into their best form, you need to form a strong bond and never let them down!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/33a11eb222ea52be240f164d9f5aa39221776599.png[/img]

In addition, we’ve added a game changing, beneficial feature to the game that allows players to teleport back home directly at any point of the game, that is [b]Mini Totem[/b]! Traveling back home in style has never been so easy. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/54d573f0340424f23e886139c80e4b7786060ced.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/d1cf95eb912586b0fc58a332a3034fc73685f7e6.png[/img]

The Mini Totem is sold at Emilia’s Shop for only 200G and it can help you out in your adventure by teleporting you and your partners back to safety within seconds. You no longer need to be afraid of late night adventures and will be able to travel further within a single day. 

Coming up next, we will be getting into one of the core feature changes that will impact your playstyle by a lot and add depths into the crafting feature. To improve the quality of your equipment in the game, we have made adjustments to them by [b]adding Grades to the crafting outcome[/b]. Every piece of equipment that you have crafted will have their own unique traits and contribute differently to your character’s strength. With this addition coming into the game, no 2 pieces of equipment will feel the same again. The final Grade of your crafted items will be depending on your crafting skills and how well you handle the mini-game. There are [b]9 different Grades in total[/b] and try it out yourself in the game and tell us if you like the changes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/8184b52db83f1834ddfe464aa4c627d1a8a2af0f.png[/img]

As you can see on the image above, both of the equipment are Thornfluff Cap but they are very different in terms of power. Supreme Grade is definitely stronger than Excellent because it’s base stats is stronger and it also gives more Enhancement slots but despite having better base stats, both pieces of equipment are actually giving different sets of utility. Excellent Grade Thornfluff Cap is giving +15 Physical DEF while Supreme Grade Thornfluff Cap is giving +20 Magic DEF. At the end of the day, it is up to your decision on which piece of equipment to use as the circumstances that you will overcome could be different so pick wisely!

Last but not least, we have the [b]Mailbox system![/b] The NPCs in the village(Or outside) can finally send you mails! There will be mails that are gonna be sent to you throughout the years and be prepared to receive them periodically. You will be [b]receiving information regarding the village’s festivals or receiving items[/b] as you progress through the game. We’re not gonna spoil the content of the mail because that’s for you to find out! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/4781cb47430123173340e8775a87eff04717574b.png[/img]

[h3][b]UI Updates[/b][/h3]

Besides working on new features, we have also taken the time to reflect on a few User Interfaces and decided to tweak them so that we can further improve them from a usability and aesthetic standpoint. Most of the tweaks are also done to ensure uniformity of the various UIs to make sure it is up to standards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/41e4989a165800a40c0a951b0752d054e4b76385.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/c9c5d74ba78a6dbfe8250de44e8b8a37f5e94696.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/21c719c21b57b14f0f8edc82ccdc32c5d99c738b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/2335b7fd82ccfb889dc98a01366b4ab9e5a7b907.png[/img]

[h3][b]VFX Updates[/b][/h3]
Alongside UI updates, we have also made several upgrades to Re:Legends various visual effects or VFX. We have made certain pop ups clearer and added more contextual pop up effects to let the players know what is happening on their screen. The improvements and additions are on pop up text, skill up, level up and many more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/c77cd9108432752bf1506b21f9f16b23a779d146.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/d6bcaad8b442251603f9b3aefbc54eb0d3ae3cce.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/3bff757f8b6ed6debfedb7c641bb6ea3e636e108.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/f0a86d416494a908578d93142a5407b315563949.png[/img]

[h3][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h3]

One of the aspects of Re:Legend that we worked on heavily for the past few months are game balancing. To ensure that Re:Legend provides a smooth but still challenging experience, we have done a lot of testing and retesting to tweak the current experience of the game so that it delivers the best Re:Legend experience that it can.

Here are the list of things that have been tweaked and balanced:
[list]
[*] Combat
[*] Status Effects
[*] Stamina Cost
[*] Player Stats
[*] Player Leveling Pace
[*] Magnus EXP
[*] Magnus Stats
[*] Magnus Changes
[*] Magnus Evolution Requirement
[*] Magnus Favourite Food
[*] Life Skills
[*] Weapon Skills Exp Requirement
[*] New Items
[*] Story Balance
[*] Fishing Minigame
[*] Equipments
[*] Game Economy
[*] Equipments Selling Price
[*] Loot Drops Selling Price
[*] Ore & Ingots Price
[*] Item Drop Rates
[/list]

The complete change log will be linked at the bottom of the update and if you are interested in reading the full extent of the balance changes, do check them out!

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
Besides game balancing, the team has also been working really hard to iron out as many bugs as we can. Currently we are focusing on eliminating as many bugs as possible for the main features, multiplayer and npc and visual glitches. Game stability is also the main focus as it leads to a smoother experience overall. 

A complete list of bug fixes will also be linked at the bottom of the update and if you are also interested in reading that, do check them out as well!

[h3][b]Multiplayer & Localization[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/564473a731c3a366268fcbf639bfcd591173b22a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/04ae911c2dc0ea977a896c13c7559ee8d6cc80dd.png[/img]

Multiplayer is currently being worked on and various aspects of the multiplayer are being tackled by the team to eliminate as many hiccups in the game to ensure that the game will have great multiplayer experience on release. Stability in multiplayer is also a main focus of the team and we are working hard to achieve that. We have managed to get the multiplayer quality up to a certain degree and we would need your help to improve it further. Do let us know if you have encountered any issue during the multiplayer session as we’re constantly improving the multiplayer experience.

As for localization, we are currently working with various parties to ensure that the game can be played in various languages such as Japanese, Chinese, Thai, French and more. We are excited to see Re:Legend breaking the language barrier and hope everyone can enjoy the game. We plan to release the supported language within the coming month as we have a final stretch to reach before it is deemed worthy of being released.

So what do you guys think of this month’s Kickstarter Update? Are you excited for the Early Access patch update for Re:Legend? Do let us know in the comments and social media platforms listed below. And if you are interested in reading the full changelog and bug fixes of the game please do check them out below. We hope to see you all again on the next Kickstarter Update and we cannot wait to watch you play! :)

notes.title: Re:Legend Major Patch Bug Fixes Log: Part I
notes.notes:
Welcome to the complete bug fix list for Early Access update patch. The team has been working hard to iron out all the bugs that have been found either from reports from the community and the bugs found internally through countless testings. Many thanks to the community for all the help and reporting of bugs which helped us tremendously in our mission to deliver a smooth gameplay for everyone!

Without further ado, here are the complete bug fix list:
[list]
[*] [PC][Graphics] Invisible object is observed near Zan village bridge after giving rope to Caren
[*] [PC][Design]Terrain clipping is noticed at Tundra and Everdust biome
[*] [PC][Design]The town upgrade status bar in the carpenter shop is not showing from level 2 to level 3
[*] [PC][Design]The NPCs are missing in the marriage room
[*] [PC][Art]The festival art is missing in the style shop in the trading zone
[*] [PC][Graphics]Texture is missing for the pathway in the 'Obelisk platform' area
[*] [PC][Graphics][Treasure of the Sea] Rippel fish art is missing during event
[*] [PC][Audio] Application audio fails to pause on minimizing the application
[*] [PC][Multiplayer] Client gets stuck when hosts pauses the game during the client successful crafting animation
[*] [PC][UI] Preview of Wilking magnus goes out of bound in Partners Tab
[*] [PC][Language] Changed languages revert back to English upon re-launching
[*] [PS4][A.I Pathing][Festival] NPC's wandering at same location while returning from beach area after completion of 'Beach day' event
[*] [PC][Art]The 'Ice Cube Hat' and 'Shiny Ice Cube Hat' art is missing on the character in the inventory screen
[*] (Internal) Tamed Magnus Affection Bug
[*] [PC][Functionality] Scrolling functionality is not smooth in Fish Selection screen
[*] [PC][Text] Text overlaps on Mini Map inside witch shop at vokka gate

Welcome to the complete bug fix list for Early Access update patch. The team has been working hard to iron out all the bugs that have been found either from reports from the community and the bugs found internally through countless testings. Many thanks to the community for all the help and reporting of bugs which helped us tremendously in our mission to deliver a smooth gameplay for everyone!

notes.title: Magnus Lore Reveal #56 Specto
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/ca076854f05c7fe94de94eaca7401dc1b300cd3d.png[/img]

Haunting the halls deep within the ruined castle of the fiery lands of the Ruined Kingdom are a bunch of peculiar looking Magnus. This family of Magnus are named Specto and the unevolved Spectos are quite indifferent to the presence of humans. Meanwhile their evolved forms, Spectral and Spectoreldr are highly aggressive and attack anyone they see on sight.

The Specto are often seen floating around with a bright red jacket that seems to get more elaborate as they evolve. Despite their ethereal looks, the Spectos are adept at close combat. They are equipped with sharp claw-like hands that are capable of dishing out painful attacks to their target. Spectos can also wail out loud causing anyone in its proximity to feel fear and have their bodies not obey them.

Spectos are often seen lurking around ruined settlements and nowhere else. This leads people to believe that they are dead souls who can’t pass into the afterlife lingering around with a heavy grudge ready to pounce on any living soul it sees.

Head Librarian,
Figaro

notes.title: Magnus Lore Reveal #55 Frozknight
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/d7a295f1dd74f5dc8adc95b1a135d55b889786f0.png[/img]

Deep within the Frigid Tundra lies a towering Magnus covered in shards of ice serving as its weapon and armor. Frozknights are one of the few Magnus in Ethia to have some form of martial arts and are quite adept at using their sword and shield made of ice. Frozknights are sometimes seen training young Frozsquires and Frozpages on their swordsmanship, displaying finesse in their movements despite being huge in size.

Some interesting points on the Frozknights is that they only develop their ice shield only after evolving into a Frozknight. The Frozpage and Frozquire seem to lack an ice shield in their arsenal and are missing in their swordsmanship altogether. It has also been found that Frozknight’s ice weapons and armors contain more minerals which aids in their toughness and also adds color to their appearances.

Frozknights are very territorial and when they encounter trespassers within their territory, they would first give them a warning by banging their sword on their shield asking them to leave. If the trespassers do not leave, they will not hesitate to attack. Frozknights are formidable opponents and it is best to steer clear from fighting one lest it might just be the last fight you will ever fight. 

Head Librarian,
Figaro

notes.title: Magnus Lore Reveal #53 Psybeak
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/8e37d3709065c4a1ccf8258bbd4ed829446bdb30.png[/img]

In the far away volcanic lands of the Ruined Kingdom lies a peculiar avian species. This avian species was given the name Psybeak. The Psybeak seems to favor the fiery atmosphere of the land it populates. Despite having colorful feathers resembling flickering flames all over their body, they do not however possess even an ounce of magical power and are a purely physical Magnus species.

Despite having such a luscious plumage of feathers, Psybeaks seem to have tough bony armor all over their heads, wings and legs suggesting that it evolved the ability to grow those armor to aid in their attacks. Psybeaks have also been observed to have two evolutionary paths which focuses on two different body parts that are used when they strike their enemies. 

Psybeaks are often seen in packs roaming beneath volcanoes and it is said that they like the warmth of the ground below an active volcano. They also love eating fruits grown in fertile lands which was probably the reason why they settled around an active volcano in the first place. When you encounter a pack of Psybeaks, run the other way and try not to anger them or you will get mobbed by them all at once.

Head Librarian,
Figaro

notes.title: Re:Legend's Road to 1.0 Milestone Update #3
notes.notes:
Hey guys, there’s big news on the horizon, and we’re going to start sharing really important bits and pieces that will lead to the eventual big reveal! This time, we will be diving into some of the things that the team are doing to push the game closer to completion. Are all of you excited? Well, let’s get right to it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/5577543ceffa75765c9ad9d911b0c05365e6e4e4.jpg[/img]

We know that there are many of you out there from all different parts of the world, so our team has been working on the localization efforts for Re:Legend. The game is currently being translated and localized into many different languages, like [b]French, German, Spanish, Japanese, and Chinese[/b]. Everything from the menu options to the character dialogues are being translated into the many languages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/04ae911c2dc0ea977a896c13c7559ee8d6cc80dd.png[/img]

Once we’ve pushed out the feature, you can just go to the options menu to change your preferred language. We want everyone to be able to enjoy Re:Legend, so doing this will introduce the least barrier to entry for players that are not from an English speaking background. Let us know down in the comments what language you will be playing Re:Legend in, and what language would you like to have supported?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/6db7d12b933bb21f6a80d78ddef936979881f828.png[/img]

Another step that we have been working on is on the optimization of the game. Since Re:Legend will not only be releasing on PC, but also on various consoles, we have put in a lot of effort in order to optimize the performance of the game for each platform. Our team has been engaged in the effort to make the game run smoothly no matter what platform you play on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/07cffbcf8fc774b22110a857c44e4757d1196cbc.png[/img]

Most of the scenes in the game have been modified in order to reduce memory usage when playing through them. Now they will load faster and take less effort for your machine to run the game, which ultimately will increase the FPS of the game. Doing things like combining meshes of static objects and replacing high draw call shaders will allow the game to be played with great performance no matter on whichever platform you are on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/9e34b1051b297fd115675c3d171818b4b1593370.png[/img]

More balancing work has gone into the game as development is nearer to 1.0. This time we addressed the Magnus item drop rate, which will affect the item crafting and magnus evolution systems. We want to nail the experience of having to put in enough effort to make the rewards impactful, but also not make the entire process a tireless grind.

For the economy of the game, prices of items in shops and also services like healing and smithing have been looked into and prices were adjusted to fit the current economy of the game. Players will need to make smart decisions in order to accumulate wealth and spend to their heart’s desire. (Hint : Use the Farm.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/689f0b6c58de3233ab9215380f67d58a327e63cb.png[/img]

Other than content changes, we know that everyone is waiting for 1.0’s release date but the team is still working on intensive testing to make sure Re:Legend is running well on all platforms. As we are getting close to revealing the date, plenty of changes and overhaul has been made to the game since the last major patch so we have decided to [b]roll out a major patch for the current content[/b] to test out the stability of the game. We’re expecting to [b]release the overhauled patch at the end of next month[/b] so expect a lengthy patch note when it hits the Steam store! If you have any questions, please let us know in the comment section below or message us on the many social media platforms listed below. We hope to see you all on the next kickstarter update!

notes.title: Magnus Lore Reveal #52 Slikat
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/0414b34f2561a1404077d5785c1764e27d3206cf.png[/img]

Lurking under the snowy layers, safe from the dangerous winds of the Tundra, hides the soft and jelly-like Slikat. Having no magical aptitude whatsoever, the Slikat is at a severe disadvantage compared to its other magic wielding neighbours. However, using its natural ability to stretch and reform itself, the Slikat is able to evade many of the magical dangers that populate the Frozen Tundra.

The amorphous properties of the Slikat’s body is truly a marvel to behold. During my expedition to the Tundra, it took nearly 2 months before I saw my first Slikat, and before I could write down any of my observations it disappeared from view. The local penguins took me to an area where the Slikats would fight, almost like an arena, and told me that the Slikat victors would often consume their opponents.

The Slikats have one advantage in the Tundra though, and it is also one of their biggest weaknesses. It is able to do large amounts of physical damage to anything in its way, and the other creatures of the Tundra are generally protected against magical assaults. This would mean that the Slikats are actually highly effective at fighting other Tundra magnus, though they would also be defeated just as quickly if attacked by magic.

Head Librarian,
Figaro

notes.title: Magnus Lore Reveal #51 Cragriz
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/c830e60ea69e7920a0ad50c7462b264a24b19998.png[/img]

Dune Kingdoms and Sand Princes, the Everdust Empire stood as the pillar of Ethian civilization. Scholars of the time debated about how their illustrious Empire would fall, many posit that it would be the constant infighting among the Highprinces, or it would be rebellion amongst the populace, or maybe even an attack from the bow wielding savages. None would suspect the very protector of the land itself, the Agriz.

Agriz is the embodiment and personification of rage, known to many as the most violent of all the Guardians of Ethia, he is as much feared as he is revered. However, most that would have worshipped him would be gone from the now empty and decaying Everdust. Apart from the handful of those that still remain, the ruins of the desert provide few with a place that they could call home.

Unlike most of the other Guardians, Agriz can often be seen roaming the deserts in search of someone or something to fight. Its powerful punches often send shockwaves through the dunes, moving sand in violent waves in all directions. Many believed that the Highprinces angered Agriz and was brought low for their hubris, but this is still speculation. Curiously, the Library holds no records of the fall of the Everdust.

Head Librarian,
Figaro

notes.title: Re:Legend's Road to 1.0 Milestone Update #2
notes.notes:
Heyyo Peeps!! How have you been this past month? We here at Magnus Games hope that all of you have been well and are not going through too much difficulties at this time. If you are feeling a bit down, we hope that you can find a bit of joy or excitement reading through this month’s Kickstarter Update, as we have quite a few nuggets of news to share with all of you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/a5d217e2a19caa27d48deb786be09deee8863fed.jpg[/img]

To start it off, we would like to address some of the feedback and comments that we have received in the past month. Firstly, we understand the concerns that have been brought up by the backers and are working our best to remedy the situation. So, let’s start off by introducing the PC exclusive cosmetic item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/7d8512f1eb34c03cea6528c62e19d97aedd6ead8.png[/img]

So far a lot of work has gone into polishing Re:Legend in order to get it ready for release. Magnus and Player stats have been polished in order to allow for more variety in builds and archetypes. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/163bbb5caa99d4b238bf3c73fc95c7357ed273a9.png[/img]

notes.title: Magnus Lore Reveal #48 Sabuk
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/ab57f45f0ee03aa7499f86577390635f3b5599f8.png[/img]

The desert sands of the Everdust betrays the wealth of life that can be found beneath the surface. Home to arguably the most powerful empire that once existed in Ethia, the Everdust was a vibrant metropolis of culture and knowledge. All of that is sadly gone, an age long past, like the wind through the dunes. Remnants of such a civilization can still be seen however, clinging to life, the unnatural Sabuk.

Undeath is a concept foriegn to the magics of Ethia, though many have claimed to be Necromancers, there is no contemporary evidence of such magics being practiced or even existing for that matter. The Sabuk look to be a collection of a human-like skeleton, animated and wielding powerful weapons, protecting the now barren ruins of the old Everdust Empire. The bones radiate powerful magic, and are tougher than the regular bones of a human.

There seems to be a latent intelligence within each member of the Sabuk, it becoming more apparent as the Sabuk rises through the ranks and claiming the position of Lich, Knight or Ranger. Members of the Library are known to have conversed with many a Sabuk, usually in a cordial and almost civilized manner. Many will speak of the Heralding of the Champion, a time when the Everdust will need to be defended from a great and overwhelming threat.

Head Librarian,
Figaro

notes.title: Magnus Lore Reveal #47 Sparkler
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/fd9f4ee7b222fddd824c0a37334b5c53670b460c.png[/img]

Many travellers and adventurers to the Fallen Kingdom would recount the Sparkler as a common sight to behold while traversing through the ruins. The image of a lantern bearing fiery wisp often comes up for many of the modern illustrations of the now volcanic wasteland. According to Library records however, this wasn’t always the case, Sparklers used to be a much rarer occurrence before the Corruption.

The prevailing theory for the origins of the Sparkler is that they are the Souls of the Lost. Persons who have shuffled off the mortal coil, with either regret or vengeance, souls that could not pass on to the realm beyond, left to wander forever seeking. The light of the Sparkler’s lantern also works in a mysterious manner, it will shift directions and shine in weird angles as if guiding the little blue wisp to where it must go.

A recent controversy among the scholars of magnus, is the notion that the Sparkler is in fact not actually a soul, but simply a manifestation of emotion. This goes against all the literature that has come before, explaining the boom in the Sparkler population after the Corruption. The new theory posits that the wisps are actually a manifestation for the emotion of hate, using the evolutions of the sparkler as proof of the eventual increase in violence to bolster the hypothesis.

Head Librarian,
Figaro

notes.title: Magnus Lore Reveal #42 Mamber
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/c7e691c709fb8ecfdc910da83dc848406d8a7700.png[/img]

From an age long forgotten by the denizens of Ethia, the Highprinces ruled over the Everdust with an iron grip, instilling the virtues of loyalty and subservience whilst upholding tradition and their supposed divine appointment to the Thrones in the Desert. The Bow was considered a holy weapon, only to be wielded by the nobility and their closest confidants. There were however, situations when the Highprinces’ bows were not the best tool for the job, when daggers and poison were needed to be rid of unsavoury characters. For this the Highprinces had the Mamber.

The usage of tools are usually an indicator for advanced intelligence for an organism. Though not particularly gifted in solving puzzles or building structures, the Mamber is incredibly deft with a dagger and applies highly advanced fighting techniques that other more intelligent practitioners find hard to grasp. Their daggers are usually made from stone or large claws that have been sharpened and will usually be crafted by the wielders themselves. 

The Mambers were the best candidates for stealth operations during the times of the Highprinces, they were able to move around quietly, jump astonishingly high, and squeeze through narrow passages. Though they are no longer employed as assassins by any monarch or organization, they remain as a dangerous force to be reckoned with. I would advise not to confront any Mamber unless absolutely necessary. Also don’t try to fight them, unless you like poison being spat in your face.

Head Librarian,
Figaro

notes.title: Magnus Lore Reveal #41 Sparkfox
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/633dd252dac7ba0557490245861f09f26ff439b6.png[/img]

Throughout history, the denizens of Ethia have always believed in the story of the World Tree and how it was the source of all creation. Though the exact details and players may vary in the retelling between cultures the general sequence of events remain unchanged throughout the years. There is however a peculiar culture that resides in the far eastern fringe of Ethia that have their own set of myths and creation stories, far removed from the Goddess and the Tree tale that is shared by most others. The Sun Goddess, Mother of All Things, the Cleansing Fire, and according to legend the origin of the Sparkfox.

Sparkfoxes can be found in the Volcanic remains of the Old Kingdom, gliding throughout the corrupted lands in search for evildoers and ne'er-do-wells. Even before the fall of the Kingdom to corruption, Sparkfoxes were known to track down criminals and burn those that have done particularly heinous crimes. The Guards of the Old Kingdom have often reported seeing wisps of flame guiding and pointing them to places where criminals are hiding or if someone is in need of help.

The Cleansing of Sins, the fires of the Sparkfox burns with righteous fury. Anything that it deems worthy of being cleansed will be met will a barrage of unrelenting fire. There are times when the sparkfox acts as a second conscience for people that have done small crimes or acted in a bad way. The sight of the sparkfox looking squarely at you is normally an indicator enough of one not acting in the right way and should apologize for whatever wrongdoings were committed that attracted the sparkfox to them.

Head Librarian,
Figaro

notes.title: Re:Legend's Current State And Road to 1.0!
notes.notes:
Hey guys! How is everyone doing? This month we have some very exciting news to share with all of you. We also have some updates on our current workflow and what the Magnus Games team is working on during this period. With the current Covid-19 pandemic, we hope that everyone out there is staying safe and healthy. Make sure to practice safe conduct and social distancing to reduce the risk to yourself and your loved ones around you. We here at Magnus Games Studio are still working remotely, but we are still hard at work to get this game to something we hope all of you will love.

So let’s start it off with a bang, we have some very good news to share with all of you. We are expecting to release our 1.0 version of Re:Legend sometime in Q4 of 2020, and yes this will include the release of the console versions of the game as well. We thank all of you that have been patient with the development of the console versions and we understand the feedback of those who have been waiting for the game to come out on console. Still, we are determined to release the best possible product for all the platforms that we will be releasing on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/c9c028ff406fef9b629d5cbd4b18fbc197d03367.png[/img]
So, what can you expect from the 1.0 release of Re:Legend. Firstly, it will have the complete story for Re:Legend and the quests will bring you to the epic conclusion of your tale in the World of Ethia (for now). We will also be releasing new Biomes for you to explore, which will include new characters, new quests, and of course new Magnus to encounter. We will also be adding all new features that are not available in the current version of the game, and will be reworking some of the features in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/a1af84531b700b294817693b206fb300ff578b0c.jpg[/img]
Many of you might have noticed, especially those of you that have the Steam Version of Re:Legend, that the updates have been pretty slow as of late. We would like to sincerely apologize for keeping all of you waiting, and we would like to reassure you that we are still working with the same fervour and determination since the beginning of the project. 

To ensure everything goes according to plan, we held off on all the new content before it is ready because the game requires a lot of bug fixing before it is truly enjoyable. We know that the last patch was made in March 2020 and we’re sincerely sorry about that and there have been a lot of improvements since then.

Due to the fact that we’re developing the console version in parallel with 1.0 release, it is difficult to stabilize the game during the development phase hence we have decided to put everything on hold till it is complete. Our current plan is to release all the new content and patches in 1.0 to make sure the experience is wholesome and you will not feel as frustrated as before with all the annoying bugs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/861131042fd9dec7df541a4d2c0cdb5fb3527885.png[/img]
With that being said, we will be releasing a road-map for our 1.0 release and revealing them as we move forward. As you can see in the road-map above, we have also summarized all the things that have been done thus far. All the things in the list from March onward will be added to the game during 1.0 release so don’t freaked out if you don’t see them in the game right now. They will be in the game soon enough! :)

Not only are we working on the new for Re:Legend, we are also taking your feedback and improving the current systems and features that we have in the game. We have reworked the UI and Multiplayer system, changed how you view and interact with quests, and also cleaned up features like the Barn and Fish Pond so that players can have a better time experiencing them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34489002/65da48cbb775f647b354365e635e1193d026e486.png[/img]

The team is also doing the final steps of development for the game as it gets closer and closer to the release date. Currently we are going through a thorough Quality Assurance and Bug Testing process in order to weed out whatever pesky bugs are lingering in our code. We are determined to get the game to the point where most if not all bugs are ironed out before its release.

Get ready to mark your calendars soon, we have many more exciting things to share really, REALLY soon. Cheers!!
